item.title: Nike’s Stylish Air Max Skate Sneaker Becomes a “Pinksicle” Sweet Treat
item.description: Nike SB's Air Max Ishod continues its stylish streak, releasing in a tasty "Hemp/Pinksicle" colorway.

item.title: Playboi Carti Made Your Dad's Favorite Skate Brand Cool Again
item.description: This is how Playboi Carti quietly revived No Fear for the modern day. Thank Carti's Opium for helping rebrand the Y2K streetwear brand as something newly edgy.

item.title: Careful, adidas' Killer All-Black Jellyfish Sneaker Might Sting
item.description: Pharrell Williams & adidas are back with more collaborative Jellyfish sneakers, this time offered in a stealthy all-black colorway.

item.title: The OG Fishing-Fashion Label Is Now More Fashion, Still Fishing
item.description: South2 West8 is the OG fishing-fashion label but the Japanese NEPENTHES sub-label is looking particularly fashionable for Fall/Winter 2026.

item.title: Nike’s Thinking Pink (& Black CdG) for Its Elderly Running Shoe
item.description: BLACK COMME des GARÇONS gets its own Nike LD-1000 collaboration, dressing the archival sneaker in a classic black & pink colorway.

item.title: Thank A Ma Maniére for This Beautifully Faded Nike Runner
item.description: A Ma Maniére designs a Nike V5 RNR sneaker collaboration, after delivering luxe iterations of Air Jordan 4s & Air Max 95s.

item.title: Andrew Reynolds' New Balances Are Skate-y, Dad-ish & Timeless All the Same
item.description: Andrew Reynolds' skate-y New Balance Numeric 933 Black Eclipse is super versatile thanks to an understated build that's easy to style with an everyday wardrobe

item.title: This Destroyed Dr Martens Shoe Is a Stealth Raf Simons Revival
item.description: Dr Martens' exposed steel-toe shoes are a subtle reference to a forgotten Raf Simons collaboration from years back, demonstrating the designer's influence.

item.title: New Balance's Gorgeous Dad Shoe Goes Full Green Goblin
item.description: New Balance's emerald-green 1906F dad shoe is a super techy take on a humble sneaker.

item.title: NIGO & Nike Made A Wooly Varsity Jacket... For the Feet
item.description: For the NIGO x Nike Air Force 3 Low ‘Midnight Navy’, the legendary Japanese designer enlists the help of Pendleton for a wool upper that recalls varsity jackets
